a.lede: Microsoft is revamping Copilot into a singular AI workspace, mixing your projects and agents together. It will also be able to support third-party frontier models.
a.title: Microsoft revamps Copilot with new tools, support for frontier models

b.lede: Microsoft says Copilot has gotten ‘actually really good.’ The new app has AI agents and can write code. So how much is all this going to cost?
b.title: Microsoft’s new Copilot app puts everything in one place – but the price is ‘evolving’
